verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.mangopay.com that contains an explicit 'Instructions for AI Agents' section. The first-party 'Build with AI' page documents clean Markdown versions of every page via a `.md` suffix, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs directly. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents actually consuming these docs, and fuller documentation of the llms.txt contents beyond the probed excerpt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: For clean Markdown of any page, append `.md` to the page URL
You can access the markdown version of any page by adding `.md` to the page URL.
